cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this ARN CSTR video on the Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎收看這支介紹 Microsoft Agent Framework 的 C# AI 影片。

cues.en: In this video, we're going to look into the Kodak and Hyperlite integration.
cues.zh: 這次要介紹 CodeAct 與 Hyperlight 的整合。

cues.en: So, you might ask, what is Kodak? What is Hyperlite?
cues.zh: 你可能會問：CodeAct 是什麼？Hyperlight 又是什麼？

cues.en: Well, it has also to do with the tool calling, and tool calling in a different way.
cues.zh: 這同樣與工具呼叫有關，只是採用不同的方式。

cues.en: Because when you have traditional tool calling in a LLM, we, of course, have our prompt and our tool definitions,
cues.zh: 傳統的 LLM 工具呼叫會提供提示詞與工具定義，

cues.en: and then we ask the LLM to do some kind of task in that prompt.
cues.zh: 再透過提示詞要求 LLM 完成某項工作。

cues.en: And it might need to use three different tools in order to do that.
cues.zh: 它可能需要使用三種不同工具才能完成。

cues.en: And the way tool calling is working is, of course, that the LLM gets the request and tells back how to call the tool,
cues.zh: 流程是 LLM 收到請求後，告訴我們該如何呼叫工具，

cues.en: then get back, call the tool, get back, call the tool.
cues.zh: 取得結果後再呼叫下一個工具，接著再繼續。

cues.en: So, we're not only doing one request and response, but for every single tool call, we're doing multiple requests.
cues.zh: 所以不只是一次請求與回應，而是每個工具呼叫都需要額外往返。

cues.en: And that means that we are wasting tokens and time because there is this back and forward all the time.
cues.zh: 這些不斷往返的過程，就會消耗時間與 Token。

cues.en: Kodak is yet another way of trying to do something similar, but instead of sending all these different tool calls
cues.zh: CodeAct 是另一種完成類似工作的方式；它不再反覆送出不同工具的呼叫，

cues.en: and giving it all the definitions, which can be token costly, Kodak wants to do one tool.
cues.zh: 也不必把所有耗費 Token 的工具定義一股腦交給模型，而是只提供一個工具。

cues.en: They want to do one tool that can execute code.
cues.zh: 這個工具能夠執行程式碼。

cues.en: So, instead of all our tools in the definition, we just give an execute code tool.
cues.zh: 因此不必列出所有工具，只提供 ExecuteCode 工具。

cues.en: The LLM gets that and builds up a piece of code to do the same task as we do up here,
cues.zh: LLM 收到後，會產生一段程式碼，完成剛才同樣的工作，

cues.en: but it only has this tool, and it knows that that tool has various underlying tools to do this.
cues.zh: 只是它現在只看得到這個工具，也知道工具內部還有其他工具可以使用。

cues.en: So, we still do normal tool code in C Sharp and so on, but it just happens to be now that it's a piece of code
cues.zh: 我們仍然像平常一樣用 C# 撰寫工具，但現在是由一段程式碼，

cues.en: that executes those tools instead of it's the LLM coming back and saying, I need to call this, I need to call this.
cues.zh: 來呼叫這些工具，而不是讓 LLM 一次又一次要求呼叫。

cues.en: So, it's a more orchestrated one call to the LLM, get back how would I do this in these three steps of calling these tools.
cues.zh: 所以編排方式變成：只向 LLM 詢問一次，讓它寫出依序呼叫這三個工具的程式。

cues.en: The execution tool then executes the code, gives that back to the LLM, and then get the result.
cues.zh: 執行工具負責執行程式碼，將結果交回 LLM，再取得最終答案。

cues.en: So, we save some tool calls, and we have a more orchestrated way of doing this.
cues.zh: 這樣能減少工具呼叫往返，也更適合編排工作流程。

cues.en: But, of course, since we are executing code now, it is a bit insecure because we need to have that code run in a sandbox.
cues.zh: 不過現在會執行模型產生的程式碼，因此必須在沙箱中執行，避免安全問題。

cues.en: So, we have seen code interpreter videos in the past
cues.zh: 之前的影片介紹過 Code Interpreter，

cues.en: where we let the LLM use Python code up in the cloud if you use the responses API.
cues.zh: 使用 Responses API 時，可以讓 LLM 在雲端執行 Python 程式碼。

cues.en: But, of course, that is costly because someone needs to run that code.
cues.zh: 不過雲端執行會產生費用，因為需要有人提供執行環境。

cues.en: This code can run locally, but again, since it's insecure, we need some way to sandbox that code.
cues.zh: 現在這些程式碼可以在本機執行，但同樣需要沙箱隔離。

cues.en: And that is where Hyperlite part comes in.
cues.zh: 這就是 Hyperlight 的用途。

cues.en: So, Hyperlite is a set of NuGet packages that allows for code execution in sandbox,
cues.zh: Hyperlight 是一組 NuGet 套件，可以讓程式碼在沙箱中執行，

cues.en: not using C Sharp, that's not part of the spec, but it can use JavaScript or Python.
cues.zh: 目前規格不包含 C#，但支援 JavaScript 或 Python。

cues.en: So, this is the setup.
cues.zh: 整體架構就是這樣。

cues.en: Let's see a few examples.
cues.zh: 我們來看幾個範例。

cues.en: So, in my sample repo, I have something called Code Act here, and in that I put in an introduction.
cues.zh: 範例儲存庫中有一個 CodeAct 資料夾，裡面放了入門範例。

cues.en: We might make more videos going forward.
cues.zh: 之後可能還會再拍更多影片。

cues.en: But let's just set a breakpoint, and let's run the code here.
cues.zh: 先設個中斷點，執行這裡的程式碼。

cues.en: So, it's just getting started.
cues.zh: 現在正在啟動。

cues.en: And let me move this a bit.
cues.zh: 先把這個視窗移一下。

cues.en: Getting started.
cues.zh: 開始執行了。

cues.en: And let me move the console in here as well so we can see.
cues.zh: 再把主控台移過來，方便一起查看。

cues.en: There we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: So, we are just nearing up a new client, like always.
cues.zh: 一開始和往常一樣，建立新的用戶端。

cues.en: In this case, we are just using JTP 5.4 Mini.
cues.zh: 這個範例使用 GPT-5.4 mini。

cues.en: And then let's try to use Code Act with JavaScript, meaning Hyperlite JavaScript,
cues.zh: 接著用 JavaScript 的 CodeAct，也就是 Hyperlight JavaScript 版本。

cues.en: because Code Act is just the way of executing the code, and the JavaScript is the sandboxed environment.
cues.zh: CodeAct 是以程式碼執行動作的方式，而 JavaScript 是沙箱中的執行環境。

cues.en: So, we're going to make an agent like normal, but what we're going to do is we're getting one AI contact provider that is new,
cues.zh: 像平常一樣建立代理程式，不過這次加入一個新的 AI Context Provider，

cues.en: and this package, you need to go in and have the new Microsoft Agents AI Hyperlite NuGet package in order to be able to react to this.
cues.zh: 因此需要安裝 Microsoft.Agents.AI.Hyperlight NuGet 套件，才能使用這些功能。

cues.en: So, we're simply just saying, always use execute code for calculations, write the code in JavaScript, show the result,
cues.zh: 指示很簡單：計算一律使用 ExecuteCode，用 JavaScript 寫程式，並顯示結果。

cues.en: and in my case, I've also said, show the code you used to do it.
cues.zh: 我另外要求它顯示實際使用的程式碼。

cues.en: And then we have our question here.
cues.zh: 接著是這裡的問題。

cues.en: Let's get rid of this.
cues.zh: 先把這個移開。

cues.en: We want to calculate the 20th Fibonacci number, divide it by 42, and subtract by 30,
cues.zh: 我們要計算第 20 個費波那契數，除以 42，再減掉 30，

cues.en: just so it has a little extra thing to do than just Fibonacci.
cues.zh: 讓它除了費波那契數之外，還要多做一點運算。

cues.en: And in some cases, this can actually be done by an LLM without any tools, but that's not the point here.
cues.zh: 有些情況 LLM 不靠工具也能算出來，但這不是這次的重點。

cues.en: But we make our agent like normal, and we call the agent.
cues.zh: 接著照常建立代理程式並呼叫它。

cues.en: And what we'll see once it's done
cues.zh: 等執行完成後，可以看到，

cues.en: is that it ran, and it did a function call where it said execute code,
cues.zh: 它確實執行了一次 ExecuteCode 的函式呼叫，

cues.en: and then it sent in what code it wanted to execute, and it got a result back, and we can see the standard out here
cues.zh: 傳入想執行的程式碼，再取得結果；這裡的標準輸出，

cues.en: is the number that we need over here.
cues.zh: 就是我們要的數值。

cues.en: Let's pack it into some JSON.
cues.zh: 把它整理成 JSON，方便查看。

cues.en: So what we can see over here is that it figured out what the 20th Fibonacci number was, made the calculation, and it gave us back the right result.
cues.zh: 可以看到，它先算出第 20 個費波那契數，再做後續計算，回傳正確結果。

cues.en: And this was not just generated by the LLM.
cues.zh: 這個答案並不是由 LLM 隨意生成的。

cues.en: It actually executed this piece of JavaScript in order to do it, where it made some JavaScript code
cues.zh: 它實際執行了這段 JavaScript，其中產生費波那契數，

cues.en: and did divide by 42 and minus 30 in order to log out what that was, and that was what we saw in the output that it then used.
cues.zh: 再除以 42、減掉 30，最後輸出結果；模型再根據這個輸出回答。

cues.en: So this is just like code interpreter up in the cloud, but you can do it locally now.
cues.zh: 這就像雲端的 Code Interpreter，只是現在可以在本機執行。

cues.en: Cool. But we talked about tools, so let's see a little more with tools here.
cues.zh: 不錯。不過前面提到工具，接著多看一些與工具相關的例子。

cues.en: So we do the same as the code act here, but because we want to add tools, we are just making some options here.
cues.zh: 和剛才的 CodeAct 類似，但這次要加入工具，所以先建立選項。

cues.en: So we are making the options, and we want to use JavaScript, and we then give it a tool.
cues.zh: 指定使用 JavaScript，再提供一個工具。

cues.en: And this tool is just like we have done so many times before.
cues.zh: 這個工具和我們先前做過的範例一樣，

cues.en: It's sunny and 90 degrees, so I can even set a breakpoint here.
cues.zh: 固定回覆晴天、19 度；我甚至可以在這裡設中斷點。

cues.en: And of course, we would have multiple tools.
cues.zh: 實際上當然可以加入多個工具。

cues.en: Just having one tool over the other might not be the smart thing, but in this case, we are just getting it that way.
cues.zh: 如果只有單一工具，這種方式未必比較划算，不過這裡先簡單示範。

cues.en: Then we again make an agent, and we give our fiberlight code act provider with our options this time,
cues.zh: 再次建立代理程式，這次把選項傳給 Hyperlight CodeAct Provider，

cues.en: so it actually knows that it has a tool inside it as well.
cues.zh: 讓它知道內部還有工具可用。

cues.en: So if we do it like that, we can, for example, ask, what is the weather like in Paris?
cues.zh: 接著可以問：「巴黎的天氣如何？」

cues.en: And in normal scenarios, we would just have called that tool.
cues.zh: 一般情況下，我們會直接呼叫天氣工具。

cues.en: Now you can see it's calling the tool, but let me show you what called the tool in one second.
cues.zh: 現在也可以看到工具被呼叫，稍後會看是什麼程式呼叫它。

cues.en: And...
cues.zh: 接著……

cues.en: Oh, I'm running too far here, but let's just see the script here.
cues.zh: 我好像執行得太快了，不過直接看看產生的腳本。

cues.en: So what it did was it came back, of course, with the value, but as you can see, it was a JavaScript call that made a constant city,
cues.zh: 它最後當然回傳了數值；不過如你所見，這次是 JavaScript 先建立 city 常數，

cues.en: and then it made a call tool, which is part of the code act specification, where it called the getWeatherForCity, which was the one that we hit down here.
cues.zh: 再呼叫 CodeAct 規格中的 callTool，指定 GetWeatherForCity，也就是剛才下方觸發中斷點的工具。

cues.en: So our JavaScript actually called back, told the C Sharp that it needed to call that tool, and got the results back for us.
cues.zh: 所以 JavaScript 會回頭通知 C# 呼叫這個工具，再取得結果。

cues.en: And you can imagine if I had three tools, then it would have been within that call this, get the result, do this about it, get the result, do this about it,
cues.zh: 你可以想像，如果有三個工具，程式碼就能在同一段流程中呼叫、取得結果，再做下一步，

cues.en: and finally produce one output instead of having the multiple tool calls.
cues.zh: 最後一次輸出結果，而不用經過多輪 LLM 工具呼叫。

cues.en: So that is the JavaScript part.
cues.zh: 這就是 JavaScript 的部分。

cues.en: Then it ran already this one, where you can see that if we want to not just do JavaScript, which is out of the box and default because it's very easy
cues.zh: 接著剛才也執行了這個範例。JavaScript 是預設支援的，因為很容易，

cues.en: to make a sandbox for that without us needing to do anything special.
cues.zh: 建立沙箱，不需要我們額外做什麼。

cues.en: If we want to use Python instead, we need to have some kind of Python sandbox, in this case an AOT, but it can also be a Wasm sandbox.
cues.zh: 但如果想改用 Python，就得準備 Python 沙箱；這裡使用 AOT，也可以使用 Wasm 沙箱。

cues.en: And I didn't know how to make this, I'm not smart with Python, but I just had my codecs AI figured out, and it gave me this file.
cues.zh: 我不太熟悉 Python，不知道怎麼建立，所以請 Codex 幫忙，最後產生了這個檔案。

cues.en: In my case, there's this extra file, it's 40 megabytes, so it's kind of big, and I can't guarantee that this works in every machine you have, so if it doesn't work
cues.zh: 這裡會多一個大約 40 MB 的檔案，算是比較大；而且我無法保證所有電腦都能使用，如果執行失敗，

cues.en: when you run this, go in and check out.
cues.zh: 就需要再檢查自己的環境。

cues.en: Just ask an AI, make this file for me.
cues.zh: 也可以直接請 AI 幫你建立這個檔案。

cues.en: But it's essentially Python packet up in a sandbox, where we can run code.
cues.zh: 基本上，就是把 Python 封裝在能執行程式碼的沙箱中。

cues.en: And then we do exactly the same as before, the only difference is that we're now using Python, and telling it to use Python to write the code.
cues.zh: 之後的流程完全相同，唯一差別是改用 Python，並指示它使用 Python 撰寫程式。

cues.en: But it also did exactly the same, and we can see that over here, where it shows the Python it used instead of some JavaScript it used.
cues.zh: 它也完成相同的工作；這裡可以看到，顯示的是 Python 程式碼，而不是 JavaScript。

cues.en: And then we have, if we don't want to have these AI context providers, we can actually just get the raw tool and the raw code.
cues.zh: 如果不想使用這些 AI Context Provider，也可以直接取得底層的工具與指示。

cues.en: So we do that by just making the same sandbox here, but then we can say Hyperlite execute code function with those options.
cues.zh: 一樣先建立沙箱，接著用這些選項建立 Hyperlight ExecuteCode Function。

cues.en: And what that produces is actually a tool, so a tool like normal, where we have a name for it,
cues.zh: 它產生的其實就是一般工具，包含工具名稱，

cues.en: and a description, and inside it will be able to do the call to the Hyperlite.
cues.zh: 以及描述；工具內部會負責呼叫 Hyperlight。

cues.en: And in order for it to understand what that is, you can also, from that tool, say, build instructions.
cues.zh: 為了讓模型知道怎麼使用，還可以對這個工具呼叫 BuildInstructions。

cues.en: So that tool can get back and say,
cues.zh: 它就能回傳相關使用指示，

cues.en: and this is actually what happens inside the AI context provider.
cues.zh: 這也是 AI Context Provider 內部實際做的事情。

cues.en: So let's quickly have a look at what the instructions it gives on the fly is.
cues.zh: 我們快速看看執行時提供了哪些指示。

cues.en: You can execute code in a secure sandbox by calling the execute tool.
cues.zh: 「你可以透過 Execute 工具，在安全沙箱中執行程式碼。」

cues.en: Any tools listed in the tools description are only accessible within the toolbox via the call tool, as we saw up here, the call tool here.
cues.zh: 「工具描述中列出的工具，只能在沙箱內透過 callTool 存取」，也就是剛才看到的這個呼叫。

cues.en: They cannot be revoked directly, so it's not by mistake begin to call some tools that are not there.
cues.zh: 「不能直接呼叫那些工具」，避免模型誤以為外層也有這些工具。

cues.en: So this is the way we can do that, and again, the tool is up here, and I think it's here in the description.
cues.zh: 這就是使用方式；工具在上面，描述應該在這裡。

cues.en: If there had been any tools extra we have given here, it would have been in this, that inside this tool, you can call this, this, and this.
cues.zh: 如果另外提供了工具，就會在描述裡列出：在這個工具內部，可以呼叫哪些工具。

cues.en: So that way, we can just put our instructions in manually, and we can put in the tools manually instead of using the AI context provider.
cues.zh: 因此也能手動加入指示與工具，不使用 AI Context Provider。

cues.en: Probably easier to do this and let it inject on the fly, but if you, for some reason, know up front that you need the tool, don't need the tool, and so on,
cues.zh: 通常讓 Provider 動態注入比較簡單，但如果你事先就知道哪些情況需要或不需要工具，

cues.en: it is possible to get them by tool calling.
cues.zh: 也可以透過一般工具呼叫方式自行取得它們。

cues.en: And then it will run like normal.
cues.zh: 之後就會像平常一樣執行。

cues.en: So pretty nice feature that is able to be sandboxed and save you a lot of tool calling
cues.zh: 這是相當實用的功能，既能在沙箱中執行，也能減少大量工具呼叫，

cues.en: if you have a lot of chaining of tools.
cues.zh: 尤其適合有很多工具需要串接的情境。

cues.en: So that is actually everything.
cues.zh: 以上就是全部內容。

cues.en: See you on the next one.
cues.zh: 我們下支影片見。
